ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which region in the diagram represents the rhizome?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a fern with a large frond on the left and another frond extending to the right. Several letters label different regions. Near the bottom of the fern, there is a basal rootstock-like region where the fronds arise and roots extend downward; the letter D is placed closest to this basal stem/rootstock area. Reasoning: A rhizome is the thick horizontal or underground stem at the base of a fern from which fronds and roots grow. Since label D marks the basal stem/rootstock region, the rhizome is represented by region D.
